summary.text: Floating Immortal Gu House and featherman city in a small world under a slightly green sky.

claims.text: A huge city floats in a small world under a slightly green sky, called the city in the sky by outsiders and Sacred Feather City by the feathermen who live there. Rainbow flags hang while the city gathers around a battle arena to choose a new featherman king after the old king’s death. Three featherman Gu Immortals, the city’s supreme elders, can control the situation even if a cruel king is chosen. When invaders under White Sea Shatuo break through a crack in the green sky, the three immortals fall back on Sacred Feather City itself: the city is a huge Immortal Gu House, and its power lets them resist that siege.

From Zheng Ling’s soul, Fang Yuan learns that this featherman clan lives for generations in a Western Desert fragment world of green heaven, and that Sacred Feather City’s origins trace to the Late Antiquity Era of Spectral Soul Demon Venerable. He treats the isolated green heaven fragment as a long sealed paradise and a major remaining featherman settlement, with Gu Immortal methods that keep Late Antiquity traits.
Later soul gains also give him a complete wind path inheritance, the immortal killer move heavenly wish, and information on Sacred Feather City and that green heaven fragment world.

A later return shows the same green heaven fragment world in Western Desert, with Sacred Feather City as the strongest headquarters of those featherman descendants, a pure white vast city floating with faint golden radiance. Western Desert immortals besiege the house with battlefield killer moves; White Sea Shatuo’s methods immobilize it so it cannot break free quickly. When a gap opens in the city wall, Fang Yuan arrives by Fixed Immortal Travel, enslaves the featherman Gu Immortal Zhou Zhong with slavery Immortal Gu, and orders him to take control of the whole city.

Zhou Zhong reports that control, but the house stays locked in place by the enemies, so Fang Yuan cannot steal it and must watch events continue. After the first supreme elder dies, the remaining feathermen abandon the Immortal Gu House, activate heavenly wish, and leave; the Western Desert Gu Immortals wait to claim Sacred Feather City once they go.

At Yi Tian Mountain the house appears under Shadow Sect control, originally owned by the featherman Gu Immortals, and Bo Qing drives it down so Fang Yuan must raise Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage to resist; Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage then blasts Sacred Feather City away.
Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord later names Sacred Feather City among seven Shadow Sect Immortal Gu Houses forced onto the field.

After the other six houses are destroyed, more than ten Shadow Sect Gu Immortals gather in Sacred Feather City as their last house, led by immortal zombie Seven Star Child, immortal zombie Bo Qing, and Ying Wu Xie.
During the standoff that follows, Sacred Feather City grows more damaged than Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage and its speed slows.

The house’s specialty is absorbing the power of wishes from past and present generations of feathermen in the city to refine wish power mortal Gu automatically. Generations of feathermen in the immemorial green heaven fragment world leave an extremely large stored stock; Shadow Sect activates those wish power mortal Gu without counting the cost so the house grows in all aspects and helps the ten extreme formation endure tribulation pressure.

After a grand tribulation wave, Sacred Feather City takes the heaviest damage among the sides named there, and later both it and Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage shatter, leaving only Heaven Overseeing Tower standing.

A tribulation-born vision from Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s own memories shows an ancient battle in the green heaven fragment world: when human Gu Masters, the then-Gu-Immortal Spectral Soul among them, invade, the featherman leader throws out Sacred Feather City, more than ten featherman Gu Immortals fly into it as it bursts out with glorious light, and the humans are utterly defeated, Spectral Soul heavily injured and barely surviving.
After Spectral Soul’s capture leaves Shadow Sect defeated, its remaining resources include construction plans for twelve Immortal Gu Houses, and Sacred Feather City is named among them.
